intro.text: A religious holiday of the Emerald Sea, kept twice a year when the sun passes behind the Verdant moon. Preachers mark the eclipse with sermons on honouring the moons and on the meaning of life.

description.text: On Diggen's Point the sermon is given from the island's highest spot.
To Tress the eclipse looks like any other moonshadow, and she notices that no two preachers agree on life's purpose, even when they trained at the same moonschool.

facts.label: Held
facts.name: Twice a year, at an eclipse
